name: @lit-core/native
description: Ahead-of-time vanilla Web Component and micro-runtime compiler for Lit

scripts.build:rs: cargo build --release && (cp ../../target/release/libnative.dylib native.darwin-arm64.node 2>/dev/null || cp target/release/libnative.dylib native.darwin-arm64.node 2>/dev/null || true)
scripts.build:rs:debug: cargo build && (cp ../../target/debug/libnative.dylib native.darwin-arm64.node 2>/dev/null || cp target/debug/libnative.dylib native.darwin-arm64.node 2>/dev/null || true)
scripts.build:debug: npm run build:rs:debug && npm run build:ts
scripts.build: npm run build:rs && npm run build:ts
